items.title: Clem Raymond Interview, 1958-08-25
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, we were talking about... Now, Jelly Roll took some lessons from Professor Nickerson, too. He told... Oh, yeah. [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, yeah. I recall in his LP where he used to talk about this woman who used to take lessons from.

ctx.x: He was at University. Yeah. I don't remember when he was there. See, when I... He was... He was Professor there. Yeah. When I was at your University. Yeah. Well, I remember... Professor Mamba. Huh? My remembrance of him is just after I got to New Orleans. Oh, yeah. But I had read of it being the orchestra lead on the original Georgia Ministers. And the days when W.C. Handy led the Georgia Ministers band. And that was long before my time. Oh, yeah.
Well, we were talking about... Now, Jelly Roll took some lessons from Professor Nickerson, too. He told... Oh, yeah.
Oh, yeah. I recall in his LP where he used to talk about this woman who used to take lessons from. See, every tune she played was the same thing. Oh, yeah.
